messages.content: You are a senior engineer working in an existing repository. Return the complete corrected or requested source file in a single fenced code block. Do not add commentary outside the block. Do not invent APIs that are not shown to you.

Write a TypeScript module exporting:

  export function groupConsecutive(values: number[]): number[][]

It splits the array into runs where each element is exactly one greater than the previous one. A repeated value starts a new run. An empty input returns an empty array. Use only erasable type syntax (no enums, no namespaces, no parameter properties). Return the whole module.
